note: TRANSLATE TEST for the size question -- the same half-compute pair a4's campaign used to prove its composition result was scale-robust rather than a short-horizon trick. At full probe compute 2.06B beats 2.88B by -0.774, but that is guaranteed by tokens/param at a small budget and cannot be read as a production answer. These two rerun the pair at HALF the compute (~600s training each). If the 2.06B advantage is LARGER at half compute, the gap is closing as compute grows and a crossover exists somewhere before production's 154B -- which would mean reopening the size decision. If it is the same or smaller, 2.06B is safe.
